title: Big Buck Bunny Trailer
description: The trailer for Big Buck Bunny, a comedy about a large rabbit who gets even with three bullying rodents. It was made by the Blender Institute as an open movie and released under a Creative Commons licence.

title: Sintel Trailer
description: The trailer for Sintel, a fantasy short about a young woman searching for the baby dragon she raised. It is the third open movie from the Blender Foundation.

title: Tears of Steel
description: A science-fiction short set in a future Amsterdam, where a group of scientists tries to save the world from robots. It combines live action with visual effects made in Blender.

title: Flower
description: A short public-domain (CC0) clip of a flower, used as a sample video in the MDN Web Docs examples.

title: Big Buck Bunny
description: The full Big Buck Bunny short film. A giant rabbit enjoys a quiet day in the forest until three rodents start causing trouble.

title: Sintel
description: The full Sintel short film. A lonely young woman sets out on a long journey to find her lost dragon friend, Scales.
